description.en: ChatGPT-style prompt autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a candidate panel follows your typing, Tab accepts the selected candidate, ArrowUp/ArrowDown switches, and Escape closes it. Rule-based and browser-local, with no model request.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的提示词自动补全：候选面板随输入更新，Tab 采纳当前候选，↑/↓ 切换，Esc 关闭；规则补全在浏览器内完成，不发起模型请求。
